title: Streaming re-auth tokens never reach long-lived BRPOP/LISTEN connections in Redis transport
author: PFacheris
body_preview: Related to https://github.com/celery/kombu/pull/2507. When using a `StreamingCredentialProvider` with the Redis transport, the periodic re-auth tokens emitted by the provider never result in an AUTH command being sent on the two long-lived connections that the transport holds: the BRPOP connection and the pubsub/LISTEN connection.
